# Generated files

All files under build/ are auto-generated by the Gleam compiler. Never read or modify them.
All `.mjs` files are auto-generated **except** the hand-written FFI
(`src/formosh/ffi/*_ffi.mjs`, `demo/src/validators_ffi.mjs`), the
hand-written E2E tooling under `e2e/*.mjs`, and the build gate
`scripts/verify-cdn-bundle.mjs`.
